statement: Broadcom projects AI semiconductor revenue rising from roughly $58 billion this year to $115 billion in 2027 and $230 billion in 2028.
why: A custom-silicon vendor guiding to revenue larger than its entire current business implies a very large block of accelerator demand routed to ASICs rather than merchant GPUs.

impact.mechanism: Growth of this scale consumes leading-edge wafers, HBM and substrates while shifting a share of hyperscaler accelerator spend from merchant GPUs to custom XPUs.

evidence.excerpt: Broadcom projects AI semiconductor revenue growth from roughly $58 billion (current year) to $115 billion in 2027, and to $230 billion in 2028.

confidence.basis: Secondary commentary outlet, single publisher; the 2028 figure is a forward projection, not a reported result.
